assistant-provider-copy.handling: Preview and one-use explicit confirmation for every configured endpoint; provider copies require scoped manual request and outcome evidence.
assistant-provider-copy.remainingLimit: Actual provider account, configuration, recipients, terms and erasure evidence unknown.

assistant-egress-approvals.handling: Session-bound single-use digests, 300 seconds, capacity 64; no stored payload or credentials.
assistant-egress-approvals.remainingLimit: Cannot undo in-flight delivery; expired entries inaccessible until lazy sweep/process end.

mail-payment-providers.handling: Assess SMTP CC, SMTP Notification, Notification External API, payment provider and final recipients separately.

browser-downloads.handling: User identifies downloads, attachments, synchronized and device backup copies; scoped manual handling.
browser-downloads.remainingLimit: No remote filesystem deletion or global erasure promise.

historical-chat-proof.handling: Independent alternative evidence for specific conversation, review/redact third-party data; insufficient proof stays unresolved.
historical-chat-proof.remainingLimit: No email matching, token recovery or automated export/erase.

deleted-chat-status.handling: Keep minimal existing request receipt; public token access ends with conversation; support verifies evidence separately.
deleted-chat-status.remainingLimit: No new token hash/status secret; MANUAL_REVIEW receipt does not prove execution.
